invariants.rationale: Method expects a non-null list of records to repartition; a null argument would risk NullPointerException.
Partition count should be strictly positive to allow meaningful repartitioning.
List.size() is always non-negative by Java List contract.
records is expected to be a List; the method signature enforces this.
Usually, the number of partitions should not exceed the number of records; if records is empty, this constraint is vacuously satisfied.
